'''Snarlclaw''' is a worgen found in a cave south of the [[Rosewick Plantation]] in [[Gilneas]]. He is responsible for the deaths of [[Dominic Larson]] and his comrades, as well as the wife of [[Maxwell Givings]].

==Abilities==
* Mind Blast
* Cleave
* Rend

==Objective of==
* Drops [[Snarlclaw's Mane]] for {{questlong|Alliance|44+|Snarlclaw (quest)|Snarlclaw}}
* Drops [[Paw of Snarlclaw]] for {{questlong|Horde|47+|Revenge After Death}}.
